qa.question: Is EIA plant 70360 the same project as Foundry Ridge Energy Center?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 70360, Foundry Ridge Energy Center LLC, Walworth County, with three 108 MW gas combustion turbines planned for 2028. That matches the 324 MW approved at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=615911.
qa.recommendation: Treat it as a match and do not add a new plant. Type EIA 70360 into Other IDs for the location, and generators FNDRD, FNRD2 and FNRD3 into Other IDs for units 1, 2 and 3.
qa.note: Generator IDs are in the Planned sheet of the file. The plant is 3.6 km from GEM's point, which fits the commission's proposed site on the Darien Solar land.

qa.question: Should capacity stay at 108 MW per unit when We Energies says 270 MW in total?
qa.finding: The commission approved up to 324 MW at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=615911. The We Energies application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=568288, Description of Facilities, says up to 270 MW nameplate for the three GE 7E.03 turbines.
qa.recommendation: Leave 108 MW per unit, because 324 MW is the installed size the commission approved and EIA lists 108 MW each. Ask the project manager if the 270 MW figure should be tracked.
qa.note: The 270 MW may be a derated or summer figure. I did not find a table that explains it.

qa.question: Should We Energies be added as owner of Foundry Ridge before its purchase is approved?
qa.finding: We Energies filed docket 6630-BS-103 in November 2025 to acquire the project, and planned to close on October 31, 2026 if approved (https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=568288, schedule near page 23). I found no closing.
qa.recommendation: Leave the owner as Foundry Ridge Energy Center LLC. Add a note about the pending purchase and recheck after the commission rules on docket 6630-BS-103.
qa.note: The October 15, 2026 decision covers the certificate only, not the purchase.
